site: trygghansa.se same-design replica on EDS (aemcoder/64009de2, branch main)

breakpoints.note: source breakpoints, mobile-first min-width queries; stylelint writes them as (width >= Npx)

class_names.rule: source th-* BEM names with '__' and '--' collapsed to '-' (kebab-case lint), e.g. th-header__nav-item--right -> th-header-nav-item-right, th-icon--22 -> th-icon-22, th-container--wide -> th-container-wide

fonts.display: var(--th-theme-family-display) = "ApexNew","Lato",Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif — R-01, only where the source computes ApexNew (home hero h1)
files: fonts/Lato-700.woff2 (size-adjust 97.2%, @font-face in styles.css, preloaded in head.html)

content_root.main: plays the source's #content / .th-content-area (box-sizing, line-height 1.5, stripe counting)
content_root.section: main > .section = .th-section: padding-block 2.5rem / 4.6875rem >=1024; every 2nd counted section gets the #f9f9f9 stripe via :nth-child(2n of .section:not(.flush))

section_styles.flush: section outside the source content area (hero, breadcrumbs, campaign banner): no padding, full-bleed wrappers, not counted for the stripe

content_root.default_content: behaves as .th-block; h2 gets the .th-heading ramp (28/36 -> 32/42 arial 700, mb 30)
content_root.buttons: decorateButtons: **link** -> a.button.primary (th-button-primary-brand), _link_ -> .secondary (th-button-secondary-accent), **_link_** -> .accent (th-button-primary-accent); all medium size, line-height normal

icons.mechanism: CSS mask over currentColor: [class*="icon-th-"]::before { mask: var(--svg) } with one .icon-th-<name> { --svg: url(/icons/th-<name>.svg) } line per SVG (all 59 source icons are in /icons)
icons.authoring: DA :th-: -> span.icon.icon-th-; scripts.js decorateMaskIcons() (runs before decorateIcons) swaps .icon for .th-icon so no is added; add th-icon- (50/40/32/22/10) and th-icon-primary|secondary|black|neutral|inverse in block JS/CSS

header.block: blocks/header — body > header gets .th-header (sticky; mobile top -6.0625rem so logo+switcher scroll away; desktop 60px bar, centred logo, mega-menu)
header.authoring: 4 sections: brand link | segment switcher list (bold = active) | primary list (item with nested list = mega-menu: icon + label, categories = icon + link + nested link list) | right-aligned tools list (bold = accent nav button)
header.active_state: derived in JS from location.pathname: a category whose link or any sub-link is the current page or its ancestor gets th-header-subnavigation-header-active (+ th-icon-primary) and its dropdown button th-header-nav-button-active; exact sub-link match gets th-header-subnavigation-item-active; plain nav links get th-header-nav-link-active (e.g. /skadeanmalan). '/' never matches.

footer.block: blocks/footer — body > footer gets .th-footer; 4 columns >=1024, collapsible columns below
footer.authoring: 2 sections: h2 + link list per column | social links list (icon + text, text kept sr-only), logo link, copyright paragraph, legal links paragraph

chrome.links: in-scope pages root-relative; everything else absolute https://www.trygghansa.se/...

not_in_foundation: SHL offer flyout (.shl-widget, tag-injected on live after consent) — martech/dynamics decision
